name: Navajo Nation

colors.symbolism: the copper outline of the Navajo land

description: A pale buff field bearing a copper-coloured map of the Navajo Nation, the four sacred mountains at the compass points, a rainbow arc of red, yellow and blue over all, and the sun above cornstalks and livestock within the map.
history: Designed by Jay R. DeGroat and adopted by the Navajo Nation Council in 1968 — the flag of the largest Native American nation, spanning Arizona, New Mexico and Utah. The rainbow is the sovereignty of the Diné bounded only by the sacred mountains.

features.role: outline map of the Navajo Nation
rainbow arc over the four sacred mountains
features.symbolism: the protective rainbow; the four sacred mountains bound the Diné homeland
